response.sql: SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS average_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY original_language_id ORDER BY film_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Meeting the replacement-cost cutoff means a cost of at least 20.99.

alternatives.interpretation: Meeting the cutoff means a cost of at most 20.99.
